meta.name: job-changes
meta.description: Job change signal tracking for B2B outbound. Use when the user asks about job change signals, champion tracking, new role outreach, vendor amnesty period, Clay job change monitoring, or days 14-45 engagement window. Do NOT use for general hiring signals (use hiring skill) or company-level events (use company-events skill).

howto.what: 当用户询问职位变更信号时，Claude 会通过 ColdIQ 或 Clay 追踪人员换岗，并提供最佳联系时机（第14-45天）和外呼模板。

howto.what_en: When asked about job change signals, Claude tracks personnel movements via ColdIQ or Clay, recommends optimal outreach timing (days 14-45), and provides an outreach template.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about job change signals, champion tracking, new role outreach, etc., or mentions the days 14-45 engagement window.

say_en.text: Track job changes of my past customers.
say_en.note: Claude suggests using ColdIQ or Clay for historical tracking.

say_en.text: Someone just started as VP Sales at a target account. What now?
say_en.note: Claude checks the day window and gives outreach advice.
